task:
Implement the first complete tranche of issue #577 on the existing target branch. Read CLAUDE.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/development/v3-application-stack-decision.md, docs/development/pull-request-acceptance-policy.md, and the current Review Lab contracts before changing anything. Owner direction is a hard replacement while no public frontend is running: do not preserve runnable Playwright merely for gradual retirement.

A. Record the hard-cut strategy in current authority and tests. Update ROADMAP/README/CHANGES/stack decision and affected contracts so apps/web is the sole destination, the branch stays unmerged until replacement parity is complete, React is temporary source evidence only, and Cypress is the only active browser framework. Do not authorize production deployment, DB work, OAuth activation, Babylon runtime, or later Stage 27 slices.

B. Fully migrate Review Lab from Playwright to Cypress now, preserving or deliberately strengthening the Python-owned browser-summary.json schema and evaluator contract. Rebuild the existing five-viewport x four evidence-posture journeys, keyboard access, Escape close, telemetry aria-expanded behaviour, Delta 503-to-fallback correlation, API response capture, console/page-error capture, product observations, and <=4px overflow evidence. Update scripts/dev/review_lab/browser_runner.py and related names/timeouts/status fields, review_environment.py, review-lab.yml, local Review Lab docs, Windows bootstrap, artifact handling, and focused tests. Keep the Python acceptance brain; Cypress is only the browser driver.

C. Make Cypress the only active browser automation system. Port the two renderer-sync telemetry ordering assertions, add Chrome and Firefox Cypress execution, wire axe accessibility in Cypress, and establish deterministic Cypress screenshot/visual-baseline capability. Preserve the existing strict release-gate and auth-owner coverage. Remove all Playwright configs, dependencies, package scripts, setup/install workflow steps, global setup, active specs/helpers, Makefile targets, ignore entries, and active docs/contracts. Convert Stage 26 bake-off/foundation/live-route harnesses to static historical evidence: retain committed artifacts and historical docs/receipts, but remove their runnable Playwright code and dependencies. Remove dead diagnostic specs and dead dev.spec.ts/axe-playwright references. Rewrite test_e2e_harness_contract.py and all Review Lab tests to assert the Cypress-only system.

D. Branch-protection compatibility: GitHub currently requires the exact context 'Frontend v2 E2E (Playwright)'. The connector cannot safely assume administration access. Implement an explicit temporary compatibility alias/context, backed by the real Cypress job and containing no Playwright invocation or dependency, while also exposing an honestly named Cypress job. Document that the alias is administrative compatibility only and can be deleted once the required-check setting is repointed. Do not leave main or the PR unable to satisfy current protection.

E. Complete the remaining low-risk V3 cleanup identified by the read-only audit: make live API/importer strings provider-neutral; add strong local-dev/CI-only and never-V3-production banners to scripts/restore_postgres_backup.sh and scripts/rehearse_postgres_restore.sh while preserving their behaviour; add contract assertions; mark root docker-compose.yml and apps/maintenance clearly as legacy self-host/local and not V3 production or V3 backup authority; explicitly reconcile its PostgreSQL 16 scope against V3 PostgreSQL 18 without changing production; add superseded/design-only banners or corrected links for stale operational docs, including migration-ledger-implementation-plan.md and chatgpt-ops-control-plane.md where it advertises unimplemented mutating operations.

F. Validation and scope discipline. Do not access production, secrets, databases outside disposable local CI, DNS, deployment, or recovery. Do not start the Svelte feature port in this tranche except changes needed to run Cypress against the current apps/web foundation. Run focused Python contracts, lint/format/type checks, Cypress/Review Lab verification where feasible, and any repository-wide checks needed to prove no active Playwright dependency remains. Keep static historical mentions/receipts where provenance requires them; distinguish them from active tooling. Commit all coherent changes to the existing branch through the wrapper.
